fields.name: Position
fields.evidence: FinalizeCrowdState (EoCClient.dll+0xEA60C0) fills the element from the member's Vector3f position (local_1e0 = 8 bytes + 4 bytes). Game name ecl::crowds::SoundStateComponent::GroupEntityData, stride 0x14.

fields.name: LastSentCount
fields.evidence: 'Send RTPC requests' step compares +0xC with the current member count and, when different, stores it and emits SetRTPCRequests.

fields.name: Moved
fields.evidence: Byte at +0x10 set from the 'moved this frame' flag on insert and cleared for every entity in 'Mark all not moved'.

fields.name: Entities
fields.evidence: Group stride 0x60 in FinalizeCrowdState; keys (8-byte handles) at +0x20 with count +0x2C, values at +0x30 stride 0x14 (IndexedStorage<SoundStateComponent::GroupEntityData>).

fields.name: Bounds
fields.evidence: ls::Bound at +0x40 (24 bytes up to +0x58): ls::Bound::GetCenter/Merge on +0x40, a new member merges Bound(position, 0.5); members join a group whose centre is within 8 m (squared distance <= 64). Assumed min/max corners.

fields.name: StillCount
fields.evidence: +0x58 set to the number of entities in 'Mark all not moved', incremented when a non-moving member joins, reset to 0 when the group empties; used as count - moved for the RTPCs.

fields.name: Available
fields.evidence: +0x5C set to 1 when the group becomes empty (assert 'group that became empty already marked available'); groups with it set are skipped.

fields.name: Groups

Live (idle): heap pointer, capacity 1, size 1.

fields.name: FreeGroupIndices
fields.evidence: When +0x1C (size) is non-zero, an index is popped from +0x10 (FUN_180777440) and the group at that index is overwritten (FUN_180EA9030) instead of appending. Live: heap pointer, capacity 1, size 0.
